name: Red Energy Defensive Stance
Text: Endurance 2. Stops an energy attack. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: Red Energy Focus
Text: All of your energy attacks cost -1 power stages to perform to a minimum of 1 and do +2 life cards of damage for the remainder of Combat. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Red Energy Gathering Drill
Text: Once per Combat, immediately after you deal life cards of damage with a Red Style energy attack, place the bottom 2 cards of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Red Flying Kick
Text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If "Blue Flying Kick" is in your discard pile, gain 5 power stages. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Red Goku's Energy Blast
Text: Endurance 1. Energy attack. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. If used by Goku, gain 2 power stages.

name: Red Heat Seeking Blast
Text: Sensei Deck. Energy attack doing 3 life cards of damage for each Dragon Ball your opponent controls. If your opponent declared a Blue Tokui-Waza, this attack is a focused energy attack.

name: Red Jump Kick
Text: Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If successful and you declared a Tokui-Waza, lower your opponent's Main Personality 1 personality level. Remove from the game after use.

name: Red Kid Trunks' Blast
Text: Energy attack doing 3 life cards of damage. Costs 1 power stage to perform. If performed by Kid Trunks, this attack does 5 life cards of damage instead. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Red Light Jab
Text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If successful and you delcared a Tokui-Waza, lower your opponent's anger to 0.

name: Red Lightning Strike
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Costs 1 power stage to perform. If successful, lower your opponent's anger to 0.

name: Red Pressured Attack
Text: Sensei Deck. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza and if your opponent declared an Orange Tokui-Waza, discard all Drills in play. Remove from the game after use.

name: Red Solar Flare
Text: Sensei Deck. Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If your opponent declared a Blue Tokui-Waza, this attack is a focused energy attack and lowers your opponent's anger 2 levels. Remove from the game after use.

name: Red Style Mastery (WGS)
Text: Whenever you perform an energy attack, lower your opponent's anger 1 level. If your opponent stops one of your Red Style energy attacks, he discards the top 2 cards of his Life Deck.

name: Red Trap
Text: Sensei Deck only. Attach this card to your opponent's Main Personality after successfully performing an energy attack. That player cannot use Non-Combat cards while this card is attached. Remove from the game when that opponent performs a successful attack.

name: Red Videl's Elbow Smash
Text: Sensei Deck. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If performed against a Majin, this attack does +6 power stages of damage instead and lowers your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Righteous Strike
Text: Physical Attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If performed against a Majin, this attack does +7 power stages of damage instead. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Saiyan Abduction
Text: Endurance 2. Discard an ally in play. If Goten or Kid Trunks are in play, discard 2 Allies instead.

name: Saiyan Crush
Text: Physical attack doing 1 power stage of damage for each Non-Combat card your opponent has in play. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, this attack does 2 power stages of damage for each Non-Combat card your opponent has in play instead.

name: Saiyan Defensive Sphere
Text: Stops a physical attack. Stops an energy attack performed during your opponent's next "Attacker Attacks" phase. This card can stop focused attacks.

name: Saiyan Discharge
Text: Sensei Deck. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If performed against the Ginyu Force, this card stays on the table to be used 1 more time this Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Saiyan Energy Ball
Text: Endurance 1. Energy attack. If successful, place this card at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Saiyan Finger Block
Text: Saiyan Heritage only. Stops a physical attack. If used by Goten, prevent 2 life cards of damag from the next attack performed against you this Combat.

name: Saiyan Flight
Text: Sensei Deck. Physical attack doing 3 power stages of damage. If your opponent declared a Namekian Tokui-Waza, lower your opponent's Main Personality to 0 power stages.

name: Saiyan Focused Block
Text: Saiyan Heritage only. Stops a focused physical attack or stops a focused energy attack. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Saiyan Heritage Drill
Text: All "Saiyan Heritage only" cards that perform attacks do +2 power stages of damage.

name: Saiyan Jump Shot
Text: Energy attack. If successful, shuffle this card back into your Life Deck after use. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, the next energy attack you perform this Combat costs 0 power stages to perform.

name: Saiyan Kamehameha
Text: Sensei Deck. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If you and your opponent declared a Tokui-Waza, prevent 5 life cards of damage from the next attack performed against you this Combat. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: Saiyan Light Jab
Text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If successful, and you declared a Tokui-Waza, shuffle this card back into your Life Deck.

name: Saiyan Readied Attack
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If successful, prevent 3 life cards of damage from the next attack performed against you this Combat.

name: Saiyan Side Step
Text: Sensei Deck. Stops a physical attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza and your opponent declared a Namekian Tokui-Waza, your opponent may not gain power stages until the beginning of his next turn. Remove from the game after use.

name: Saiyan Style Mastery (WGS)
Text: When entering Combat, draw a card. If it is a Saiyan Style card, you may show it to your opponent and prevent 4 power stages and 4 life cards of damage from the first attack performed against you. Otherwise, prevent 4 power stages of damage from the first attack performed against you.

name: Saiyan Swift Kick
Text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If the bottom card of your discard pile is a Saiyan Style card, prevent 4 power stages of damage from the next attack performed against you this Combat.

name: Saiyan Uppercut
Text: Sensei Deck. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If performed against Pikkon, this attack does +7 power stages of damage instead. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: South Kai Sensei
Text: Once per game during your Non-Combat Step, you may search your Life Deck for a level 1 Ally and place it in play at 3 power stages above 0.

name: Straining Counterstrike Move
Text: Sensei Deck Only. Physical attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If your opponent's Main Personality is a Majin, this is a focused physical attack. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Straining Cry Baby Move
Text: Physical attack doing 5 power stages of damage. Raise your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Straining Diving Punch Move
Text: Physical attack doing 3 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, this attack does 5 power stages of damage instead. Raise your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Straining Focused Move
Text: Focused physical attack doing +7 power stages of damage. If successful, you may not use a card during your next "Defender Defends" phase. Lower your anger 1 level.

name: Straining Reversal Move
Text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. Lower your anger 2 levels.

name: Stupid Tricks!
Text: Discard a Non-Combat card in play. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. Gain 3 power stages.

name: Supreme Kai
Text: When entering Combat, look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's Life Deck and place them back in any order. Draw the bottom card of your discard pile.

name: Supreme Kai's Power Hold
Text: Energy attack. If successful, your opponent must pass during his next "Attacker Attacks" phase. Remove from the game after use.

name: Tapkar
Text: Constant Combat Power: If Tapkar has not used any other personality powers this turn when entering Combat as the defender, remove the top 4 cards of your Life Deck from the game, draw 2 cards, and raise your anger 3 levels.

name: Tapkar on the Move
Text: Tapkar only. Physical attack doing 1 power stage of damage for each of your cards that is in your removed from the game pile. Remove from the game after use.

name: Tapkar, the Fastest
Text: (You cannot win with the Most Powerful Personality Victory.) Constant Combat Power: If Tapkar has not used any other personality powers this turn when entering Combat as the defender, remove the top 8 cards of your Life Deck from the game, draw 3 cards, and raise your anger 5 levels.

name: Tapkar, the Speedy
Text: Constant Combat Power: If Tapkar has not used any other personality powers this turn when entering Combat as the defender, remove the top 6 cards of your Life Deck from the game, draw 3 cards, and raise your anger 4 levels.

name: The Middle of Nowhere
Text: All attacks with "Majin" in the title do +3 power stages of damage.

name: The Truck
Text: Discard 2 Non-Combat cards in play. If Gohan or Videl are in play, discard 1 Non-Combat card in play instead. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Torbie, the Prepared
Text: Focused physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If successful, remove the top or bottom 3 cards of your opponent's discard pile from the game.

name: Torbie, the Silent
Text: Energy attack. If successful, remove the bottom card of your opponent's discard pile from the game.

name: Torbie, Unleashed
Text: Energy attack doing 15 life cards of damage -1 life card for every card in your opponent's discard pile, to a minimum of 0.

name: Vegeta HT (WGS)
Text: Constant Combat Power: Any Vegeta Named cards that say "Remove from the game after use" now say "Discard after use" instead.

name: Vegeta, the Dark Hero
Text: When entering Combat, shuffle 3 Vegeta Named cards from your discard pile back into your Life Deck and lower your opponwnt's anger 2 levels.

name: Vegeta, the Mighty
Text: Physical attack doing 1 power stage of damage for every Vegeta Named card in your discard pile. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: Vegeta, the Proud
Text: You may search your Life Deck for up to 3 Vegeta Named cards and discard them. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: Vegeta, the Puppet
Text: Constant Combat Power: Any attacks Vegeta performs that allow him to gain anger do +3 life cards of damage.

name: Videl HT
Text: Focused physical attack doing 3 power stages of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. If successful, raise your anger 1 level.

name: Videl's Battle Ready
Text: Videl only. Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 3 levels. If your opponent's Main Personality is a villain, this attack does +8 power stages of damage instead.

name: Videl, the Determined
Text: When entering Combat, remove the top card of your opponent's Life Deck from the game. If it is a Physical Combat card, your opponent's Main Personality loses 5 power stages.

name: Videl, the Protector
Text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If you did not declare a Tokui-Waza, you may use this power twice per Combat.

name: Videl, the Student
Text: Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If your opponent is a Villain, this attack does +5 power stages of damage instead. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: West Kai Sensei
Text: Once per game during your "Attacker Attacks" phase, you may remove up to 2 Non-Combat cards in play from the game.

name: World Tournament
Text: Allies may not take control of Combat.
